ticket.subject: Re: SAML group sync
ticket.body_text:
Hi Sam Ortega,

+1 to this from our side as well. Any update on the roadmap?

Fatima

On Mon, 31 Aug 2026 at 14:14, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
> Thanks for the suggestion. Syncing groups from your identity provider into
> teams is on our roadmap, but we do not have a date yet. I have added your
> company to the request so you will hear when it ships.

> On Sun, 30 Aug 2026 at 13:07, Fatima Varga wrote:
>> We manage all our users in groups at our identity provider. It would save us
>> a lot of time if those groups could create and update teams in your app
>> automatically, instead of us doing it by hand every time someone joins.

label_notes: thread_quoted: a follow-up on a feature request = feature P4 low.
